_comment: The ONE judgment in the pipeline: which eBay category branches count as ENGINE parts (Rule B). A listing whose categoryId is a descendant of any include-ancestor -> Rule B (fitment restricted to the donor's engine). Everything else -> Rule A (whole chassis family). exclude_ids override include (forced Rule A). See docs/DESIGN.md sec 6.1. DECISIONS below are owner-confirmed (2026-08-15); numeric IDs get filled from scripts/ebay_fetch_categories.py output, then added to include_ancestors / exclude_ids.
_default_note: If a listing's category is not in the fetched tree, default to Rule B (narrower/safer): over-narrowing loses a little reach but never creates a wrong-engine false positive.
